ITEM 1 | Bowl of cubed pale off-white pieces, roughly 1.5-2 cm cubes with slightly rough, matte, porous surface and irregular edges, some faintly golden-tinged edges; piled in a mound filling most of a stainless steel mixing bowl (about 20 cm across), holding shape without flowing | 230
ITEM 2 | Thin julienne strands of bright orange carrot, about 4-6 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, scattered among the cubes and beneath them, matte with slight moisture | 25
ITEM 3 | Thin translucent white onion slices and pale purple onion rings, fanned out in thin strips about 5-7 cm long, lying beneath and between the cubes, slightly glossy and moist | 35
